result.summary: Found 1 issue: the lead card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' displays a gray broken-image icon in its large image area instead of the restaurant photo, while the '€0 delivery' badge and favorite button still render.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source so the restaurant photo loads, and use a proper fallback image or skeleton placeholder rather than the broken-image icon if loading fails.
